notes: The opening continuation explains why a general multiplication formula is not entirely explicit: it still contains u(g-prime_i). Two insertions specify seules données and mais ils s’explicitent ainsi before quand. Formula (9) treats multiplication by i(g,alpha_i); (9′) is announced under sigma=1 but literally retains sigma as the second coordinate of the right-hand tuple. That visible discrepancy is preserved, not corrected. Formula (10) gives an inner-conjugation action and the subsequent où tuple uses a semicolon after sigma. The bottom paragraph again discusses the manque d’explicitation of u(g). The word before u(g) is likely a live terme whose initial t-crossbar was taken by C as a cancellation; the draft retains both live terme and the two canceled ordinal alternatives explicitly. The inverse factor in (10) also retains an explicit correction-state variant. These observations are from the ink; no independent mathematical derivation or proof verification was performed.
The sheet carries the handwritten lower-left number 33 and no date. The final punctuation after mots) is absent on the visible page.
